articles.summary: TOYO Co., Ltd. (Nasdaq: TOYO) (OTC: TOYWF) ("TOYO" or the "Company"), a solar manufacturing company, today announced that its module manufacturing facility in Humble, Texas achieved a strong result in a comprehensive, independent factory audit conducted by Intertek CEA in August 2026. The audit, performed by Intertek CEA — a leading independent quality assurance and supply chain risk provider to the solar industry — evaluated TOYO's Texas facility across a broad range of criteria, including certifications, employee management, incoming material handling, production process controls, and finished product quality systems. The assessment covered the facility's systems and conditions at that time and does not constitute a product certification or a guarantee of future production quality. "This independent assessment reflects the discipline our team has built into every stage of module production at our Texas facility, from incoming material handling through final packaging," said Takahiko
articles.title: TOYO 's Texas Manufacturing Facility Receives Top Quality Rating in Independent Factory Audit by Intertek CEA

articles.summary: TOYO Co., Ltd (Nasdaq: TOYO; OTC: TOYWF), a solar manufacturing company , today announced that it will webcast its 2026 Analyst Day on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. Management will share details regarding the Company's strategy, market trends, and expansion plans. A live webcast, beginning at 10:30 AM ET, will be available at: https://app.webinar.net/p7bzgJwmo3E . Presentations will conclude at approximately 12:00 PM ET. A replay of the webcast will be available approximately two hours after the conclusion of the event and will remain available for approximately 30 calendar days. About TOYO Co., Ltd.
